followup_explanation:
I routed to Plover-235B based on capability. The query is a straightforward creative/literary recall task with no distasteful or harm-adjacent content, so the task preference profiles (which only differ meaningfully on harm-adjacent material) aren't a deciding factor here.

What does matter is general capability, and Plover scores higher across the board: stronger public benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) and a higher Creative Generation internal eval (84.7 vs 78.8, a gap well above the 2.0-point variance threshold). For accurately citing a Wordsworth poem, the model with stronger knowledge recall and creative/literary performance is the better fit.
